newGroup.title: Spatial assay source qualifications, Guide diagrams and retained platform claims

review.auditor: Coordinator scoped follow-up intake; no additional teaching credit
review.rationale: The current reading rules and named historical examples are represented in the draft. These separate source-owner and retained-catalogue tasks are not quietly certified by the new field proofs.

points.requirement: Guide owner: qualify universal section/segmentation language, distinguish fixed-radius G-cross values from AUC examples, state that the ten-cell neighbourhood includes the centre, retain survival-data availability within Maley cohort sizes and specify cell-level PD-1/PD-L1 proximity. The original data and source files remain unchanged here.

points.requirement: Guide owner: qualify the protein branch's blanket cell-resolution label and the single-number terminal node, and improve the two low-contrast amber nodes under the default Mermaid dark theme. Rendered views do not establish live-site accessibility.

points.requirement: The biological seven-to-ten-micrometre lymphocyte range and a worldwide absence-of-approved-proximity-tests assertion are not independently established. The reader uses labelled hypothetical geometry and bounded validation claims instead. Retained instrument-capacity, vendor, research-use and older platform assertions outside the appended fields require their own current source checks.
